# GitHub Project Description

**Short description (for GitHub About section):**
```
AI reliability layer for ERP analytics using on-policy distillation. Answers natural-language business questions over SQL-backed ERP systems and improves from real usage via per-token learning signals.
```

```
On-policy distillation for ERP analytics. Reliable AI reasoning that learns from usage via per-token reverse KL divergence.
```
